title: Agent Harness Event Coalescing Policy
description: Closed cooperative coalescing configuration for reducing event volume while preserving critical audit labels.

windowMs.description: Time window in milliseconds for coalescing events (default 10 minutes)

queueMax.description: Maximum queue size before forcing flush (1-256, default 256)

preserveLabels.description: Event labels that must never be coalesced; must include all four: lifecycle, tool, permission, error

dlpOverride.description: DLP coalescing override; must be true for cooperative mode
